errors.evidence: The bar for the first category, "蒙古" (Mongolia), clearly extends above the 1000 tick mark on the y-axis. Describing its frequency as "close to 1000" is inaccurate; it is over 1000 (approximately 1080).

errors.text_span: 其余地点如“华山”“嘉兴”“临安”“江南”“牛家村”“重阳宫”“中原”“终南山”的频次均在100至200次之间
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The bars for "牛家村" (approx. 80), "重阳宫" (approx. 70), "中原" (approx. 65), and "终南山" (approx. 65) all have frequencies below 100.

Describing the bar heights of the last eight locations as "相近" (similar) is an over-generalization. There is a clear and steady decrease in height, with the bar for "华山" (approx. 130) being roughly double the height of the bar for "终南山" (approx. 65).
